Visual Predictive Check (VPC or pc-VPC) from NONMEM simulation output

Source: R/nm_vpc.R
nm_vpc.Rd

Reads the _orig.fit and _sim.fit files produced by nm_vpc_ctl, computes observed and simulated percentiles in time bins, and returns a ggplot2 VPC or pc-VPC plot.

Usage

nm_vpc(
  run,
  analysis_dir = NULL,
  col_names,
  type = 1,
  pi_low = 0.05,
  pi_up = 0.95,
  ci_low = 0.025,
  ci_up = 0.975,
  bin_method = 4,
  TTIME_seq_manual = NULL,
  n_bins_quantile = 8,
  bin_rule = "FD",
  plot_title = NULL,
  plot_file = NULL,
  show_hist = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

run

Path of the estimation run, as given to nm_vpc_ctl: its control stream ("C:/project/run001.ctl"), its run directory or its stem ("C:/project/run001"). The function looks for run001_orig.fit and run001_sim.fit, looked for in run001_orig.reg/ (resp. _sim.reg/), .nm7/, a folder of the same name, then directly in the folder of the run.

analysis_dir

Deprecated (former form run_name + analysis_dir): when given, run is read as the run name in this directory, with a warning.

col_names

Character vector of column names matching the $TABLE output columns in the .fit files (e.g. c("NSIM","ID","TIME","AMT","MDV","DV","PRED","IPRED")).

type

Integer. 1 = standard VPC (default), 2 = pc-VPC (prediction-corrected, Bergstrand 2011).

pi_low

Lower bound of the prediction interval (default: 0.05).

pi_up

Upper bound of the prediction interval (default: 0.95).

ci_low

Lower bound of the confidence interval around simulated percentiles (default: 0.025).

ci_up

Upper bound of the confidence interval around simulated percentiles (default: 0.975).

bin_method

Integer. Binning method: 1 = manual, 2 = equiprobable quantiles, 3 = nominal time points, 4 = automatic (default: 4).

TTIME_seq_manual

Numeric vector of bin breaks. Required when bin_method = 1.

n_bins_quantile

Number of bins for quantile method (bin_method = 2). Default: 8.

bin_rule

Rule for automatic binning (bin_method = 4): "Sturges", "Scott", or "FD" (default).

plot_title

Character. Title of the VPC plot. If NULL (default), a title is generated from the run name and type.

plot_file

Character. If provided, the plot is saved to this path (e.g. "vpc_run001.jpeg") through nm_export_plot (.jpg, .png, .pdf or .tiff).

show_hist

Logical. If TRUE (default), prints a diagnostic histogram of observed TIME with bin boundaries before the VPC plot.

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: run_name (now run).

Value

A ggplot2 object, displayed when not assigned.

Details

pc-VPC correction (Bergstrand 2011, Eq. 1, lb = 0): $$DV_{pc} = DV \times \tilde{PRED}_{bin} / PRED$$ where \(\tilde{PRED}_{bin}\) (MEDpred_ref) is the median of all simulated PRED values pooled across replicates within each bin. The same reference is applied to both observed and simulated data.

Required packages: ggplot2 and dplyr must be installed (listed in Imports).

See also

nm_vpc_ctl for generating the simulation runs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
col_names <- c("NSIM", "ID", "TIME", "AMT", "MDV", "DV", "PRED", "IPRED")

# Standard VPC
p <- nm_vpc(
  run          = "C:/analyses/my_pk_project/run001.ctl",
  col_names    = col_names,
  type         = 1,
  bin_method   = 4
)

# pc-VPC with manual bins, saved to file
p <- nm_vpc(
  run              = "C:/analyses/my_pk_project/run001.ctl",
  col_names        = col_names,
  type             = 2,
  bin_method       = 1,
  TTIME_seq_manual = c(0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 24),
  plot_file        = "pcvpc_run001.jpeg"
)
} # }
